full_en: Gaxos.AI is a technology company focused on reshaping the way people interact with artificial intelligence across everyday life and high-impact industries. More than a developer of applications, Gaxos.AI is building a portfolio of AI-powered solutions designed to make advanced technology more practical, accessible, and transformative. The company’s growing portfolio spans defense, health and wellness, entertainment, and productivity—bringing intelligent Gaxos.AI product studio developing and launching AI applications across fast-moving sectors. In September 2024, we launched a transformative generative AI service that empowers game developers and publishers.
